# Load Library:

```{r}

library(package = "dplyr")
library(package = "plm")
library(package = "stringi")
library(package = "ggplot2")
library(package = "tidyr")

library(package = "cluster")
library(package = "factoextra")
library(package = "magrittr")

```


# Load Precipitation Data:

```{r}

Precip <- read.csv(file = "result/Precip_Data_Monthly.csv", header = TRUE)

Precip <- Precip %>% 
  filter(Year >= 1380 & Year <= 1394) %>% 
  filter(!(Year == 1380 & Month <= 06)) %>% 
  filter(!(Year == 1394 & Month >= 07))

Precip <- Precip %>% 
  mutate_at(.vars = vars(ends_with("_Precip")), .funs = list(~ round(x = ., digits = 1)))

Precip

```



# Create Water Year Precipitation

```{r}

Precip <- Precip %>%
  mutate(Water_Year = if_else(
    condition = Month >= 7,
    true = paste(substr(x = as.character(x = Year),
                        start = 3,
                        stop = 4),
                 substr(x = as.character(x = Year + 1),
                        start = 3,
                        stop = 4),
                 sep = "-"),
    false = paste(substr(x = as.character(x = Year - 1),
                        start = 3,
                        stop = 4),
                 substr(x = as.character(x = Year),
                        start = 3,
                        stop = 4),
                 sep = "-"))
  )

Precip

```




# Load geeID:

```{r}

geeID <- read.csv(file = "dataset/Land_Based_Datasets/GIS/Land_Based_Stations.csv") %>% 
  select(Station, LAT, LONG, ELEV_SRTM3, ASPECT_SRTM3, SLOPE_SRTM3)

geeID

```



# Combine Precipitaion Data And geeID Data

```{r}

data <- Precip %>% 
  left_join(y = geeID, by = "Station")

data <- data %>% 
  mutate(Date = Year * 100 + Month)

data

```



```{r}

data_clustring_scale <- data %>%
  group_by(Month) %>% 
  summarise(Land_Based_Precip = median(x = Land_Based_Precip, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  na.omit() %>%
  scale()

fviz_nbclust(data_clustring_scale, kmeans, method = "gap_stat")

```


```{r}

data_clustring <- data %>%
  group_by(Month) %>% 
  summarise(Land_Based_Precip = median(x = Land_Based_Precip, na.rm = TRUE))

data_clustring_hc <- data_clustring %>%
  scale() %>%
  dist(method = "euclidean") %>% 
  hclust(method = "ward.D2")

fviz_dend(data_clustring_hc,
          k = 5,
          cex = 0.5,
          k_colors = c("#2E9FDF", "#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07"),
          color_labels_by_k = TRUE,
          rect = TRUE)

```



# Train & Test

```{r}

ST <- c("ABADAN", "ALIGUDARZ")

Test <- data %>% filter(Station %in% ST)

Train <- data %>% filter(!(Station %in% ST))

```


# Panel Data Model

```{r}

pData <- pdata.frame(x = Train, index = c("Station", "Water_Year"))

Model_01 <- plm(
  formula = Land_Based_Precip ~ ERA5_Precip + ERA5_Land_Precip + PERSIANN_CDR_Precip + CHIRPS_Precip - 1,
 data = pData,
 effect = "twoways",
 model = "random",
 )

summary(Model_01)

```


# LSDV Model of Panel Data Estimation

```{r}

data_train_1 <- Train %>%
  filter(Month %in% c(11))

LSDV <- lm(formula = Land_Based_Precip ~ ERA5_Precip + ERA5_Land_Precip + 
             PERSIANN_CDR_Precip + CHIRPS_Precip + 
             ELEV_SRTM3 + ASPECT_SRTM3 + SLOPE_SRTM3 + 
             LAT + LONG + 
             factor(Date) - 1,
           data = data_train_1)

# Model2 <-  glm(formula = Land_Based_Precip ~ ERA5_Precip + ERA5_Land_Precip + PERSIANN_CDR_Precip +  CHIRPS_Precip + ELEV_SRTM3 + ASPECT_SRTM3 + SLOPE_SRTM3,
#                data = data_train_1,
#                family = poisson)

summary(LSDV)

```

```{r}
plot(LSDV$fitted.values, LSDV$model$Land_Based_Precip)
# 
# hydroGOF::gof(sim = Model_01$fitted.values, obs = Model_01$model$Land_Based_Precip)

```



```{r}

Coeff = data.frame(Model_01$residuals) %>% 
  mutate(ID = row.names(x = data.frame(Model_01$residuals)))

row.names(Coeff) <- NULL

colnames(Coeff) <- c("Coeff", "ID")

Coeff <- Coeff %>% separate(ID, c("Station", "Date"), sep = "-")

data$Date <- as.character(x = data$Date)
  
df <- data %>% 
  left_join(y = Coeff, by = c("Station", "Date")) %>% 
  mutate(Panel_Data_Precip = Land_Based_Precip - Coeff) %>% 
  select(Station, Date, Land_Based_Precip, Panel_Data_Precip)


plot(df$Land_Based_Precip, df$Panel_Data_Precip, xlim = c(0, 500), ylim = c(0, 500))

```



```{r}

df %>% filter(Station == "ALIGUDARZ") %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x=as.factor(Date), y=Land_Based_Precip)) +
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x=as.factor(Date), y=Panel_Data_Precip), color="red")

```
